notes: Differential-LR fine-tuning, AdamW + cosine. Anchors come from the original DenseNet paper plus the project's CNN convention in CLAUDE.md.

head_lr.citation: papers/Densely Connected Convolutional Networks.pdf §4 — initial LR 0.1 (SGD); CLAUDE.md adapts to AdamW head LR 1e-3

backbone_lr.citation: papers/Densely Connected Convolutional Networks.pdf §4 — fine-tuning LRs an order of magnitude below head

weight_decay.citation: papers/Densely Connected Convolutional Networks.pdf §4 — weight decay 1e-4

label_smoothing.citation: papers/TResNet.pdf §3.3 — label smoothing 0.1 (DenseNet paper predates label smoothing)
label_smoothing.note: Anchor 0.1 (CLAUDE.md CNN row). Cited TResNet because original DenseNet paper does not use LS.

warmup_epochs.citation: papers/Densely Connected Convolutional Networks.pdf §4 — short warmup typical for cosine fine-tuning
warmup_epochs.note: Float; tune_all.py rounds to int. Anchor 0.
